title: briefing: the situation of one side at the start of a day, in ten parts and the objectives

enemy_ashore.description: What the side believes of the enemy's men ashore, from its ground reports (decision 0092, 19), and enemy bases a report found yesterday. Left out when the side holds no estimate and found no base.

free_forces.description: Forces that have nothing left to do (decision 0110, item 6): an unload that has landed everything, men and cargo, or a load that is complete. Left out when there are none.

away_at_yard.description: The forces away at the yard (decision 0069), each with the day it is back. Left out when none is away.

halts.description: Yesterday's halts at marked waypoints and the forces that steamed on (decision 0096, 7). Left out when there were none.

force_changes.description: Yesterday's forces formed, joined and stood down, and loads and refuellings stopped at a base's reserve (decision 0111). Left out when there were none.

shared_hexes.description: Each hex where the side holds more than one base, shown as one place (decision 0110, item 8): the stock of all its bases and the days of supply for the hex, once. The bases are still listed in bases. Left out when none.

land_units.description: The side's land units and what yesterday's events say happened to their men (decision 0066, 21). Left out when the side has no land unit.

base_changes.description: Bases that changed side yesterday and what went with them (decision 0090, 29 and 30). Left out when no base changed side and nothing was lost with one.

free_force.description: A force with nothing left to do (decision 0110, item 6).

finished.description: unloading (everything landed, men and cargo) or loading (the load is complete).

event.description: The side's number of the event that said so, when it was yesterday's. Left out for a force that finished on an earlier day.

objectives.description: The side's own mission and objectives (decision 0054), its progress as far as it can know it, what the enemy is scored for (enemy_objectives, decision 0183), and the umpire's result once the game is over. mission is null and objectives empty when the scenario has none; result is null until the game is over (and always null without objectives).

not_given_to_this_seat.description: True at a seat at a task force or a base, which is not given the side's mission and objectives: they are the area command's (decision 0138, 5). Left out otherwise.

levels.description: From day 1: the margins (a side's points less the enemy's) that make a minor, a major and a decisive victory; the same margins against a side are defeats of the same level, and a margin of less than minor either way is a stalemate. null when the scenario has no objectives.

enemy_objectives.description: What the enemy is scored for (decision 0183): his objectives in the scenario's order, each with its kind, its base, open or shut and its worth, and nothing of his mission, his progress or his state. Left out when the scenario has no objectives and at a seat at a command; empty when the enemy has no objectives.

enemy_objective.description: One objective of the enemy's (decision 0183): what it is and what it is worth. It has no field for a count, days counted, points earned, a basis or whether a base is open now.

base.description: The base of cargo_landed, base_open, base_held and men_landed, by the map's number and name; a base not on the reader's map is given by its hex, handle "(q,r)" and name null; null for the others.

closed.description: For base_open: true if the enemy is scored for the base being shut, false if open. Null for the others.

ship_points.description: For ships_sunk, ships_crippled and ships_out_of_action: the points for each kind of the reader's ships (for ships_out_of_action, for a ship away for the whole horizon). Empty for the others.

horizon_days.description: For ships_out_of_action only (left out for every other kind): the days of the horizon its shares are of (decision 0088), at least 1.

points_per_1000_t.description: For cargo_landed only (left out for every other kind): the points for a thousand tons, which is points times 1,000. The text gives the worth by this.

points.description: Points for one aircraft, one ton, the base as wanted on every day, the base held at the end, each 100 men lost or each 100 men landed; null for the ship objectives.

open_now.description: For base_open only (decision 0110, item 4): whether today would count, from the side's own facts now. Left out for every other kind.

yours.description: Whether the base is the side's own now. When it is not, nothing counts until it is, and the other fields are left out.

supply_t.description: The supply at the base now.

aircraft_ready.description: The aircraft ready of the groups at the base.

open.description: Whether the base is open now: supply above 0 and an aircraft ready.

counts.description: Whether today would count for the objective as it is worded: open, or with closed, shut.

missing.description: What is missing for the base to be open; left out when it is open.

days_seen.description: The days the side saw this base's day end while it was its own, and how many of them ended open. Left out when none.

base.description: The base of cargo_landed, base_open, base_held and men_landed; a base not on the reader's map is given by its hex, handle "(q,r)" and name null. Null for the others.

ship_points.description: For ships_sunk, ships_crippled and ships_out_of_action: the points for each kind of ship (for ships_out_of_action, for a ship away for the whole horizon). Empty for the others.

horizon_days.description: For ships_out_of_action only (left out for every other kind): the days of the horizon its shares are of (decision 0088), at least 1.

points_per_1000_t.description: For cargo_landed only (left out for every other kind): the points for a thousand tons, which is points times 1,000. The text gives the worth by this.

points.description: Points for one aircraft, one ton, the base being as wanted, the base held, each 100 enemy men lost or each 100 men landed; null for the ship objectives.

known.description: What the side knows of its progress, from its own units and the events it may see. basis is exact, claims (the enemy ships and aircraft the side's own claims say it sank, shot down or destroyed on the ground: they can be wrong, so count can be above the truth; points are for the kind of ship each claim names, or null where none does) or not_observable (count is 0 and says nothing).

days.description: For base_open at a base of the side's own: the days counted, which count is out of. Null for everything else.

result.description: The umpire's result for both sides, from the truth, told at the end of the game.

history.description: What happened in the real battle, not in this game: the scenario's note of how the day went in history, in words and not a computed score. It is not this game's result. null where the scenario gives none.

base.description: As for an objective line: a base not on the reader's map is given by its hex, handle "(q,r)" and name null.

days.description: For base_open: the days counted, which count is out of. Null for the others.

horizon_days.description: For ships_out_of_action only (left out for every other kind): the days of the horizon the shares are of, at least 1.

ships_out.description: For ships_out_of_action only (left out when empty): each ship counted, in ship number order, with the days it was away and the points they earned.

ship.description: The side's own handle for a ship of its own (ship:7), with no name; for an enemy ship, which a side has no handle for, enemy_ship:3, her place in this list from 1.

at_end.description: Her days of repair still to run at the end of the game.

left_with.description: The days of repair she left for a yard with.

points.description: The kind's points times the share.

margin.description: This side's points less the other side's.

level.description: minor, major or decisive; null for a stalemate, which has no level (outcome says it in words).

outcome.description: The outcome in words: "minor victory", "major defeat", "stalemate" and so on.

last_day.description: The last day of the game: it ends when this day has been resolved. Null if the briefing was made without it.

rules_in_play.description: Which optional rules are in play; the text leaves out what a rule not in play would make meaningless.

reason.description: The engine's own words, with a short hint in brackets of what the order needs where the reason has one.

strike_report.description: What a strike reported back: an event that cites its attack or its finding nothing.

estimates.description: One estimate for each hex, in hex order.

bases_found_yesterday.description: Enemy bases a ground report put on the side's map yesterday (decision 0092, 15). Left out when none.

found_empty_yesterday.description: Hexes where the side's own men found no enemy man ashore yesterday, and the estimate cleared (decision 0110, item 10). Left out when none.

men.description: The men of the estimate cleared.

reported_day.description: The day that estimate was reported; 0 for an opening estimate.

weapon.description: What the raid attacked with: a raid on a base is with bombs (decision 0167, 1).

recognised.description: The type of the aircraft, by the name its data has, where the base's people recognised it; null where they did not (decision 0167, 2).

hits_on_men.description: Hits that landed on men ashore (decision 0092, 10). Left out when 0.

bombardments.description: Shore bombardments the side's own forces made last night (decision 0092, 17): the shells and the weighed shots, never a hit; what the side believes it did is in its claim. Left out when none.

shell_fire.description: What each of the side's own ships fired in those bombardments and the rounds it has left. Left out when none.

bombardments_against.description: Shore bombardments of the side's own bases last night (decision 0092, 18): the fire and where each hit landed, never the force or the ships that fired. The aircraft and supply destroyed are in losses and the bases, the men lost in land_units. Left out when none.

weapon.description: What the ship was attacked with. Air attacks on one ship are counted by weapon, as salvos are (decision 0167, 1).

recognised.description: The types of aircraft the ship's people recognised in these attacks, by the names their data has, each once, in the order first recognised (decision 0167, 2). Empty for salvos.

not_recognised.description: The air attacks counted here whose type was not made out; 0 for salvos.

cause.description: Given only for a ship lost to a fire among her aircraft (decision 0212).

aircraft_fires.description: Fires among a carrier's aircraft in the day just resolved (decision 0212): the side's own carriers only. While one burns she can fly no aircraft off or on. Left out when none.

written_off_by.description: Why they were written off, by cause (decision 0110, item 9): wear after a sortie, or damaged aircraft left behind by a rebase. The aircraft add up to written_off.

sortie.description: For wear: the sortie, such as patrol or base strike.

base.description: For rebase: the base the group left.

no_deck.description: Left out when 0. Aircraft that were in the air when their own deck was lost, found no other carrier with room and no base within reach, and came down in the sea.

ditched.description: Left out when 0. Aircraft that ran out of fuel on the way home from a strike or escort sortie beyond their radius, and are lost.

aircraft_landed_elsewhere.description: Left out when none. Aircraft that were in the air when their own deck was lost (the ship sank or her flight deck went out) and landed at another carrier or a base: from is the group they flew in, to the group that has them now (an existing one, or one formed by the landing), at the ship or base.

air_groups_rebased.description: Left out when none. Air groups moved to another base by a rebase order on the day just resolved (decision 0091). The group flew nothing that day. Its damaged aircraft, which could not fly, were written off at the base it left and are counted in aircraft as written_off.

ready.description: Ready aircraft that went with the group.

pilots.description: Pilots that went with the group; null where its pilots are not counted.

claims.description: Claims yesterday: what the side's own people believe they did in a fight at sea or a raid. They can be wrong. A claim from the air (from_air true) says hits on ships and the kind they were taken for, ships sunk, aircraft shot down and aircraft destroyed on the ground; a claim of a fight at sea says ships sunk only, with the rest 0 and null; the claim of a shore bombardment (from_bombardment true, from_air false) says aircraft believed destroyed on the ground and nothing else.

from_bombardment.description: True for the claim of a shore bombardment (decision 0092, 17). Left out when false.

ground_types.description: The types of the aircraft claimed destroyed on the ground, by name, each with its number, where the raiders made them out (decision 0179). Left out where none is named.

air_types.description: The types of the aircraft claimed shot down, by name, each with its number, where the claim's men made them out (decision 0210). Left out where none is named.

claimed_by.description: Who claims what (decision 0180): each of the side's own units whose fire the claim rests on, with what it claims, in the order it first fired. Left out for a claim that names no unit.

since_dissolved.description: True for a unit no longer in the game. Left out otherwise.

event.description: The event that told the side; explain on it shows the side's own firing it rests on.

repaired_ship.description: A ship a base mended yesterday by forward repair (decision 0069): the points spent on her, what she has left of fire and flotation damage, the systems put back to working yesterday, and the systems she still has degraded or out.

formed.description: Ships in port in no force formed into a new force.

charges_lost.description: Decision 0121, 7: escorts whose charge was sunk, stood down or joined; each has no charge now and stopped where it was. Left out when none.

rearmed.description: Decision 0122, 9: ships that took main battery rounds and torpedoes at a base, one line for each ship and pulse. Left out when none.

fuelled_at_sea.description: Decision 0201: ships that took fuel at sea from an oiler of another force, one line for each ship and pulse. restored is true where the force was out of fuel and no longer is. Left out when none.

fuel_t.description: The fuel aboard the ship afterwards.

oiler_cargo_fuel_t.description: The cargo fuel the oiler has left.

fuelling_broken_off.description: Decision 0201: fuelling at sea that passed no fuel in a pulse because a raid attacked a ship of either force or either fought a surface action. Left out when none.

fuel_orders_ended.description: Decision 0201: orders to fuel from another force that ended. Left out when none.

reason.description: full (every ship is full), giver_empty (the giver holds no cargo fuel), no_oiler (the giver has no ship afloat that fuels others at sea) or new_route (a new route was ordered).

joined.description: Forces joined to another at a base; the joined force has ceased to be and keeps its number.

stood_down.description: Forces stood down at a base: their ships lie in port in no force and the force has ceased to be.

loads_below_reserve.description: Loads the commander ordered that may take tons of the stock below the base's reserve. tons is the tons below.

loads_held_at_reserve.description: Loads the staff ordered that stopped at the base's reserve. tons is the tons aboard the force.

refuelling_held_at_reserve.description: Ships still short of fuel because the fuel at their base was at its reserve.

halted.description: Forces that halted at a marked waypoint to act there.

at.description: The clock time it halted, such as D1 22:00.

waits_for.description: The reason it halted: bombard, cargo and night (it stood for the night, decision 0124), those that apply, in that order.

steamed_on.description: Halted forces that steamed on, each with the reasons.

reasons.description: Why it went: bombarded, cannot_bombard_any_longer (no ship could fire any longer), cargo_work_done and the_night_is_over (a stand for the night, decision 0124), those that apply.

taken.description: Bases the side took yesterday, with the stocks it kept and the stocks lost in the change.

lost.description: Bases the side lost yesterday. The stocks left in them are the new holder's and are not given.

air_groups_lost.description: The side's air groups lost with a base.

ships_lost.description: The side's ships lost in port with a base.

home_ports_lost.description: The side's task forces whose home port was lost.

strike_missions_cleared.description: The side's air groups whose base strike mission was cleared because the base is now the side's own.

fatigue_rule.description: The rule of fatigue of this scenario (decision 0110, item 3). Left out where the scenario has no ground figures.

attack_day.description: Added by a day of attack.

failed_attack.description: Added besides on a day the side's attack failed. Left out when 0.

march_day.description: Added by a day of march.

strain_per_day.description: The most a day under fire adds (strain). Left out where the strain rule is off.

rest_per_day.description: Taken off by a day of rest.

attack_limit.description: Above this a unit on attack goes back to defend.

no_activity_yesterday.description: Units that were to work, train or rehearse yesterday and did not, and why (decision 0110, item 1). Left out when none.

up_to.description: For at_ceiling: the experience training stops at.

event.description: The side's number of the event that shows the reason (the march, the fight or the feeding), where one does.

landings_yesterday.description: What each force's landing came to yesterday (decision 0110, item 7). The ships' lines are in landed_yesterday and explain gives each. Left out when none landed anything.

finished.description: True when nothing is left aboard.

finishes_in_days.description: Days to land the rest at yesterday's rate (men and tons each at their own, the longer, rounded up). Left out when finished, and when some part of the rest was not landed yesterday.

event.description: The side's number of the first event of the landing yesterday.

from.description: The unit that kept its men ashore elsewhere.

land_unit.description: The new unit made of the men aboard.

base.description: The base loaded from; null off a bare shore.

cargo.description: supply or fuel; null for a load of men only.

base.description: The base asked; null where the side has none in the hex.

ship.description: The ship lost with, for lost_with_ship.

place.description: The hex of an unfed, fight or fire loss.

ashore.description: What the unit has left ashore there, for unfed, fight and fire.

fights_yesterday.description: Fights ashore the side's men were in yesterday (decision 0090, 28): the hex only, never which side attacked. Left out when none.

fire_yesterday.description: The side's own units' fire in yesterday's fights: firing men and shots, never the chance or the hits. Left out when none.

fatigue_yesterday.description: Changes of the side's own units' fatigue yesterday. Left out when none.

change.description: gained (on attack and fired), rested, marched or marched_and_attacked (decision 0094, 8), landed (the unit's first men landed from a ship, decision 6 of 0095), or strained (bombs or shells landed on the side's men in the unit's hex, so it did not rest: under fire, did not rest, decision 10 of 0106).

fieldworks_yesterday.description: Changes of the side's own units' fieldworks yesterday (decision 0106, 5, 6 and 12): units that dug in, whose fieldworks fire wore down, or that left them. Left out when none. The enemy is told nothing of it.

change.description: dug (the unit dug in where it stands), worn (hits on men wore the fieldworks down) or lost (the unit marched, fell back, was taken aboard or was set to attack, and left them).

defences_worn_yesterday.description: The side's own bases whose defences hits on its men wore down yesterday (decision 0106, 12). Left out when none. The enemy is told nothing of it.

hits.description: The hits on the side's men in the hex that wore the defences.

back_to_defend_yesterday.description: Units on attack too tired to go on that went back to defend yesterday; the posture order is spent. Left out when none.

fed_share_restored_yesterday.description: Units with no man ashore whose fed share went back to 1. Left out when none.

marches_yesterday.description: Marches the side's own units made a day of yesterday (decision 0094, 11). The men are still in from unless days is of_days. Left out when none.

march_arrivals_yesterday.description: Marches that ended yesterday: the unit's men arrived (decision 0094, 4 and 9), with the supply carried from the bases left and the base it went into (null when none was carried). Left out when none.

bases_formed_by_march_yesterday.description: Bases a march formed yesterday to hold the supply it carried (decision 0094, 9): the side's own, on its own map only. Left out when none.

marches_stopped_yesterday.description: Marches that stopped short yesterday (decision 0094, 3), with the days marched and why: ordered, no_men_ashore or no_land_link. Left out when none.

attacks_failed_yesterday.description: The side's own attacks that failed yesterday (decision 0105, 4 and 9): the hex and the event, never the weights of fire. Left out when none. The enemy is told nothing of it.

fell_back_yesterday.description: The side's own units that fell back yesterday, after a defeat (decision 0104) or with their attack spent (decision 0105): from, to, the men and the fatigue after. Left out when none. An enemy unit's falling back is never told.

reason.description: beaten (the side was beaten in the hex) or attack_spent (the unit's attack was spent and its order said fall_back, or its default did).

surrendered_yesterday.description: The side's own units that surrendered yesterday with nowhere to fall back to (decision 0104). Left out when none.

prisoners_taken_yesterday.description: Enemy men who surrendered yesterday, as the side learns of it (decision 0104): where and how many, never which unit. Left out when none.

loading_yesterday.description: Loading gained or lost yesterday by the side's forces preparing a landing (decision 0095, 4, 5, 8 and 10). Left out when none.

loading_before.description: The loading before a loss. Left out for a gain.

reason.description: Why it fell: new_landing_place, unit_added, or spent (the landing is done and the order with it). Left out for a gain.

rehearsal_yesterday.description: Rehearsal gained or lost yesterday by the side's units (decision 0095, 3, 7 and 8). Left out when none.

task_force.description: The force whose roster the unit rehearsed for. Left out for a loss.

rehearsal.description: The rehearsal afterwards for a gain; the rehearsal before for a loss (a loss takes it to 0).

reason.description: Why it fell: new_landing_place, landed or other_landing_place. Left out for a gain.

roster_left_yesterday.description: Units that left a force's roster yesterday (decision 0095, 7 and 3c of 0099). Left out when none.

preparation_shared_yesterday.description: Forces that split yesterday and gave the new part their preparation (decision 12 of 0095). Left out when none.

units.description: The units of the roster the new part took.

experience_days_yesterday.description: Days of training and of firing counted yesterday toward a step of experience (decision 0097, 3 and 5). Left out when none.

days.description: The days counted toward the next step.

experience_raised_yesterday.description: Steps of experience gained yesterday (decisions 3 and 5 of 0097). Left out when none.

men_joined_yesterday.description: Replacement men who joined the side's units yesterday (decision 0197), from its own MenJoined events. Left out when none.

men_after.description: The unit's men afterwards, ashore and aboard together.

joined.description: The unit's count of men joined since its experience last changed, after the night: 0 on the night it lost a level.

work_yesterday.description: Work made yesterday by the side's units (decision 0099), from its own UnitWorked events. Left out when none.

total.description: The work done on the airfield, the day's work on the port or on the aircraft, or the defences after the day.

airfields_built_yesterday.description: Airfields of the side built yesterday (decision 0099, 5). Left out when none.

supply_by_hex.description: For each hex with men of the side ashore: the side's lowest-numbered base there, the first that feeds them, and its other bases there (left out when none; the men are fed from every base of the side in the hex), the aircraft at those bases, their stock together, what the aircraft and the men cost a day, and the days the stock lasts at that charge (truncated to one decimal; null without a base or with no charge).

aboard.description: The unit's men in the ship afterwards.

ashore.description: The unit's men ashore in the hex afterwards.

as_of.description: The moment the area command's held state of the base is of, where that is not the pulse just ended (decision 0136, 11). Left out otherwise.

ammunition_t.description: The base's ammunition (decision 0122), which its side's fights ashore spend first (decision 0209, 5). Left out while the base has none.

planned_days_of_supply.description: Today's days of supply in the base's hex (decision 0107, 31 to 36): the side's supply there over its planned use for a day, read before the day's orders; no figure where nothing is used. The side's figure for the hex. Left out for a base in a hex where the side holds more than one base (decision 0110, item 8): the figure is then in shared_hexes, once. Not days_of_supply, which is the stock over yesterday's spending.

formed_by.description: Given when a landing or a march formed the base (decision 0110, item 8). Left out for a base that was there at the start.

ships_in_port.description: The side's ships in port at the base in no force (decision 0111): form_task_force takes ships from here. Left out when there are none.

airfield_yesterday.description: What yesterday's events of the side say of the base's airfield (decision 0103): hits that added damage, work that mended it, arrivals held back. Left out when there were none.

stocks_yesterday.description: Where the base's supply and fuel went and came from yesterday, by cause, from the side's own events. null when nothing moved in or out of either stock; otherwise supply and fuel are each null when that stock did not move. start_t is end_t less the net of the causes (landed less the others).

sorties_and_upkeep_t.description: Paid for sorties flown and aircraft kept at the base.

men_fed_t.description: Paid to feed men ashore (decision 0066, 16). Present only when something was paid for men.

taken_by_marches_t.description: Taken out by units that marched out of the base's hex (decision 0094, 9). Present only when something was taken.

arrived_with_marches_t.description: Put in by units that marched into the base's hex. Present only when something was put in.

used_in_fights_t.description: Spent on the side's men at grips in fights in the base's hex, where the base's ammunition did not cover them (decision 0209, 5). Present only when something was spent so.

refuelling_ships_t.description: Taken by ships to fill their own tanks.

at.description: The base or ship the group is at.

held_past_day.description: True for an arrival past its day that was held back (decision 0110, item 2).

can_be_delivered.description: Whether it would be delivered if its night came now.

waits_for.description: What holds it, when it cannot be delivered.

supply_lines.description: The side's own supply lines from off the map whose last day is today or later (decision 0196). Left out when none.

supply_t.description: Tons of supply added a night.

fuel_t.description: Tons of fuel added a night.

men_replacements.description: The side's own streams of replacement men whose last day is today or later (decision 0197). Left out when none.

to_enter.description: The side's own forces and units held apart until their day (decision 0195, 7). Left out when none is held.

entered_yesterday.description: What came onto the map yesterday. Left out when nothing did.

entry_waiting_yesterday.description: Units that could not enter yesterday and wait for their base. Left out when none.

base.description: The side's lowest-numbered base in the force's hex; none of its bases there has any fuel.

other_bases.description: The side's other bases in the hex. Left out when none.

task_force.description: The force stopped there: one warning for each force (decision 0110, item 5).

least_fuelled.description: The force's least fuelled ship and her fuel.

home_passage.description: The passage to the force's home port, by measure's own forecast. Left out when the force has no home port of the side's.

needs_t.description: For arrives: the fuel the least fuelled ship burns on the way.

steamed_nm.description: For runs_out_of_fuel: the miles steamed before a ship is dry.

task_force_propulsion.description: Task forces with a ship afloat whose propulsion is degraded or out. A force steams at the speed of its slowest ship, so a ship with propulsion out stops the whole force (effect cannot_move) and one degraded slows it (effect slowed).

strike_group_out_of_reach.description: An own air group on naval_strike that holds contacts but has none within its aircraft type's strike radius, or on base_strike at a base beyond it, at the time of the briefing: it would launch nothing. nearest is the nearest contact held (naval_strike) or the target base (base_strike); distance_nm is its air distance, the figure measure air_reach gives.

reach_nm.description: Given only for a group on extended reach: the reach in force in miles. The warning is made against it, not against radius_nm: a contact within it does not warn.

strike_group_holding.description: Left out when there is none. An own air group on naval_strike that holds contacts within its reach, none of a kind on its target list (set_target_priority): it holds its strike and launches nothing at them. nearest is the nearest contact within reach and nearest_taken_for the kind it is taken for; distance_nm is its air distance.

reach_nm.description: Given only for a group on extended reach: the reach in force in miles.
